text: Bitcoin is holding near $81k with minimal selling pressure, but Ethereum is underperforming with a sharper 3% decline, suggesting selective weakness in altcoins despite the larger crypto holding relatively steady. The Fear & Greed index at 53 (neutral, trending down) reflects cautious sentiment without panic, while Bitcoin's dominance climbing to 60.3% indicates capital rotating toward the largest asset during this period of modest uncertainty. Trading volume remains robust at $44.5B daily, signaling engagement rather than disengagement from the market.
